items: No more health bars: your animals' blows fill a creature's 💌 ring with ❤️s, and once it's full it's stunned; one more 💌 and it's yours. Your own animals take 💧s from enemy blows instead; one berry washes them all away, and if they fill up the animal runs off for good
Soundsystems show their health as a ring of 💥s, and anything running away for good wears a big 💧
